name: Computer Architecture
description: Performance analysis, instruction set architecture, pipelining, memory hierarchy, cache, virtual memory, parallelism.

name: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
description: Algorithm design strategies, complexity analysis, P vs NP. Also listed as AMTH 377.

name: Operating Systems
description: OS fundamentals, processes, memory management, I/O, file systems, security.

name: Probability I
description: Definitions, sets, conditional and total probability, binomial distribution approximations, random variables, important probability distributions. Emphasis on discrete random variables.

name: Probability II
description: Continuation of AMTH 210. Study of continuous probability distributions, central limit theorem, parameter estimation.

name: Linear Algebra I
description: Vector spaces, transformations, matrices, characteristic value problems, canonical forms, and quadratic forms.

name: Fundamental Mathematics for Artificial Intelligence
description: Linear algebra, probability and statistics, and optimization for AI. Programming in Python.

name: Computer Networks
description: Network protocols, TCP/IP, routing, wireless networks, network security.

name: Machine Learning
description: Machine learning theory, neural networks, gradient descent, implementation of ML algorithms.

name: Pattern Recognition and Data Mining
description: Data analytics methods, dimensionality reduction, classification, regression, clustering.

name: Advanced Computer Architecture
description: Advanced system architectures, instruction-level parallelism, multiprocessor configurations.

name: Deep Learning
description: Deep neural networks, convolutional and recurrent networks, applications to vision and NLP.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: NLP models and algorithms, text analysis, machine translation, large language models.

name: Computing for Good: Project Design and Implementation
description: Designing and implementing computing projects that address social good, in partnership with community organizations.

name: Software Ethics
description: Ethical issues in software engineering practice, including privacy, bias, and responsible design.

name: Project Management Basics
description: Fundamental concepts in project management: triple constraints, project life cycle, scheduling, budgeting, and monitoring/controls.

name: Technology Entrepreneurship
description: Moving from an idea to a profitable business, covering intellectual property, team formation, funding, and startup execution.

name: Innovation, Entrepreneurship and the Evolution of Silicon Valley
description: The history and dynamics of Silicon Valley's innovation ecosystem and what drives entrepreneurial success.
